controls.title: Security Management Process
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations are implemented

controls.title: Risk Analysis
controls.description: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic protected health information held by the covered entity or business associate.
assessment_objectives: Determine if risk analysis has been conducted
Determine if the risk analysis is accurate and thorough
Determine if potential risks and vulnerabilities to ePHI confidentiality, integrity, and availability are assessed

controls.title: Risk Management
controls.description: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level to comply with Section 164.306(a).
assessment_objectives: Determine if security measures to reduce risks and vulnerabilities are implemented
Determine if security measures reduce risk to a reasonable and appropriate level

controls.title: Sanction Policy
controls.description: Apply appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with the security policies and procedures of the covered entity or business associate.
assessment_objectives: Determine if appropriate sanctions are defined for workforce members who fail to comply with security policies and procedures
Determine if sanctions are applied against non-compliant workforce members

controls.title: Information System Activity Review
controls.description: Implement procedures to regularly review records of information system activity, such as audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures for reviewing information system activity are implemented
Determine if reviews of audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports are conducted regularly

controls.title: Assigned Security Responsibility
controls.description: Identify the security official who is responsible for the development and implementation of the policies and procedures required by this subpart for the covered entity or business associate.
assessment_objectives: Determine if a security official responsible for development and implementation of security policies and procedures is identified

controls.title: Workforce Security
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to ensure that all members of its workforce have appropriate access to electronic protected health information, as provided under paragraph (a)(4) of this section, and to prevent those workforce members who do not have access under paragraph (a)(4) of this section from obtaining access to electronic protected health information.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures ensure appropriate workforce access to ePHI
Determine if policies and procedures prevent unauthorized workforce access to ePHI

controls.title: Authorization and/or Supervision
controls.description: Implement procedures for the authorization and/or supervision of workforce members who work with electronic protected health information or in locations where it might be accessed.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures for authorization and/or supervision of workforce members with ePHI access are implemented

controls.title: Workforce Clearance Procedure
controls.description: Implement procedures to determine that the access of a workforce member to electronic protected health information is appropriate.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures exist to determine that workforce member access to ePHI is appropriate

controls.title: Termination Procedures
controls.description: Implement procedures for terminating access to electronic protected health information when the employment of, or other arrangement with, a workforce member ends or as required by determinations made as specified in paragraph (a)(3)(ii)(B) of this section.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures for terminating access to ePHI when employment or arrangement ends are implemented

controls.title: Information Access Management
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to electronic protected health information that are consistent with the applicable requirements of subpart E of this part.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures for authorizing access to ePHI are implemented
Determine if access authorization policies are consistent with the Privacy Rule minimum necessary requirements

controls.title: Isolating Health Care Clearinghouse Functions
controls.description: If a health care clearinghouse is part of a larger organization, the clearinghouse must implement policies and procedures that protect the electronic protected health information of the clearinghouse from unauthorized access by the larger organization.
assessment_objectives: Determine if clearinghouse ePHI is protected from unauthorized access by the larger organization

controls.title: Access Authorization
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures for granting access to electronic protected health information, for example, through access to a workstation, transaction, program, process, or other mechanism.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures for granting access to ePHI are implemented

controls.title: Access Establishment and Modification
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures that, based upon the covered entity's or the business associate's access authorization policies, establish, document, review, and modify a user's right of access to a workstation, transaction, program, or process.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures for establishing, documenting, reviewing, and modifying user access rights are implemented

controls.title: Security Awareness and Training
controls.description: Implement a security awareness and training program for all members of its workforce (including management).
assessment_objectives: Determine if a security awareness and training program is implemented for all workforce members including management

controls.title: Security Reminders
controls.description: Periodic security updates.
assessment_objectives: Determine if periodic security reminders are provided to workforce members

controls.title: Protection from Malicious Software
controls.description: Procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software are implemented

controls.title: Log-in Monitoring
controls.description: Procedures for monitoring log-in attempts and reporting discrepancies.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures for monitoring log-in attempts and reporting discrepancies are implemented

controls.title: Password Management
controls.description: Procedures for creating, changing, and safeguarding passwords.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures for creating, changing, and safeguarding passwords are implemented

controls.title: Security Incident Procedures
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to address security incidents.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures to address security incidents are implemented

controls.title: Response and Reporting
controls.description: Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents; mitigate, to the extent practicable, harmful effects of security incidents that are known to the covered entity or business associate; and document security incidents and their outcomes.
assessment_objectives: Determine if suspected or known security incidents are identified and responded to
Determine if harmful effects of known security incidents are mitigated to the extent practicable
Determine if security incidents and their outcomes are documented

controls.title: Contingency Plan
controls.description: Establish (and implement as needed) policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence (for example, fire, vandalism, system failure, and natural disaster) that damages systems that contain electronic protected health information.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures for responding to emergencies or occurrences that damage systems containing ePHI are established and implemented as needed

controls.title: Data Backup Plan
controls.description: Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of electronic protected health information.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of ePHI are established and implemented

controls.title: Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.description: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures to restore any loss of data.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures to restore any loss of data are established and implemented as needed

controls.title: Emergency Mode Operation Plan
controls.description: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures to enable continuation of critical business processes for protection of the security of electronic protected health information while operating in emergency mode.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures to enable continuation of critical business processes and protection of ePHI security during emergency mode are established and implemented as needed

controls.title: Testing and Revision Procedures
controls.description: Implement procedures for periodic testing and revision of contingency plans.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures for periodic testing and revision of contingency plans are implemented

controls.title: Applications and Data Criticality Analysis
controls.description: Assess the relative criticality of specific applications and data in support of other contingency plan components.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the relative criticality of specific applications and data is assessed in support of contingency plan components

controls.title: Evaluation
controls.description: Perform a periodic technical and nontechnical evaluation, based initially upon the standards implemented under this rule and, subsequently, in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of electronic protected health information, that establishes the extent to which a covered entity's or business associate's security policies and procedures meet the requirements of this subpart.
assessment_objectives: Determine if periodic technical and nontechnical evaluations are performed
Determine if evaluations are performed in response to environmental or operational changes affecting ePHI security

controls.title: Business Associate Contracts and Other Arrangements
controls.description: A covered entity may permit a business associate to create, receive, maintain, or transmit electronic protected health information on the covered entity's behalf only if the covered entity obtains satisfactory assurances, in accordance with Section 164.314(a), that the business associate will appropriately safeguard the information.
assessment_objectives: Determine if satisfactory assurances are obtained from business associates that ePHI will be appropriately safeguarded

controls.title: Written Contract or Other Arrangement
controls.description: Document the satisfactory assurances required by paragraph (b)(1) of this section through a written contract or other arrangement with the business associate that meets the applicable requirements of Section 164.314(a).
assessment_objectives: Determine if satisfactory assurances are documented through written contracts or other arrangements meeting requirements of 164.314(a)

controls.title: Facility Access Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to its electronic information systems and the facility or facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures to limit physical access to electronic information systems are implemented
Determine if properly authorized access is allowed

controls.title: Contingency Operations
controls.description: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures that allow facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operations plan in the event of an emergency.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures allow facility access in support of data restoration during emergency operations

controls.title: Facility Security Plan
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and the equipment therein from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and equipment from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft are implemented

controls.title: Access Control and Validation Procedures
controls.description: Implement procedures to control and validate a person's access to facilities based on their role or function, including visitor control, and control of access to software programs for testing and revision.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures to control and validate facility access based on role or function are implemented
Determine if visitor control procedures are implemented

controls.title: Maintenance Records
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications to the physical components of a facility which are related to security (for example, hardware, walls, doors, and locks).
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications to security-related physical components are implemented

controls.title: Workstation Use
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed, the manner in which those functions are to be performed, and the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation or class of workstation that can access electronic protected health information.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures specifying proper functions, manner of performance, and physical attributes for workstations accessing ePHI are implemented

controls.title: Workstation Security
controls.description: Implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access electronic protected health information, to restrict access to authorized users.
assessment_objectives: Determine if physical safeguards are implemented for all workstations accessing ePHI
Determine if physical safeguards restrict workstation access to authorized users

controls.title: Device and Media Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures governing receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media containing ePHI are implemented
Determine if movement of hardware and electronic media within the facility is governed

controls.title: Disposal
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of electronic protected health information, and/or the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures for final disposition of ePHI and/or hardware or electronic media are implemented

controls.title: Media Re-use
controls.description: Implement procedures for removal of electronic protected health information from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures for removal of ePHI from electronic media before re-use are implemented

controls.title: Accountability
controls.description: Maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and any person responsible therefore.
assessment_objectives: Determine if records of movements of hardware and electronic media and responsible persons are maintained

controls.title: Data Backup and Storage
controls.description: Create a retrievable, exact copy of electronic protected health information, when needed, before movement of equipment.
assessment_objectives: Determine if retrievable exact copies of ePHI are created before movement of equipment when needed

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic protected health information to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights as specified in Section 164.308(a)(4).
assessment_objectives: Determine if technical policies and procedures allowing access only to authorized persons or software programs are implemented

controls.title: Unique User Identification
controls.description: Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.
assessment_objectives: Determine if a unique name and/or number is assigned to each user for identifying and tracking user identity

controls.title: Emergency Access Procedure
controls.description: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures for obtaining necessary electronic protected health information during an emergency.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures for obtaining necessary ePHI during an emergency are established and implemented as needed

controls.title: Automatic Logoff
controls.description: Implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.
assessment_objectives: Determine if electronic procedures terminating sessions after a predetermined time of inactivity are implemented

controls.title: Encryption and Decryption
controls.description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information.
assessment_objectives: Determine if a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI is implemented

controls.title: Audit Controls
controls.description: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use electronic protected health information.
assessment_objectives: Determine if mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems containing or using ePHI are implemented

controls.title: Integrity
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to protect electronic protected health information from improper alteration or destruction.
assessment_objectives: Determine if policies and procedures to protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction are implemented

controls.title: Mechanism to Authenticate Electronic Protected Health Information
controls.description: Implement electronic mechanisms to corroborate that electronic protected health information has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner.
assessment_objectives: Determine if electronic mechanisms to corroborate that ePHI has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner are implemented

controls.title: Person or Entity Authentication
controls.description: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to electronic protected health information is the one claimed.
assessment_objectives: Determine if procedures to verify the identity of persons or entities seeking access to ePHI are implemented

controls.title: Transmission Security
controls.description: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.
assessment_objectives: Determine if technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI being transmitted over electronic communications networks are implemented

controls.title: Integrity Controls
controls.description: Implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted electronic protected health information is not improperly modified without detection until disposed of.
assessment_objectives: Determine if security measures ensure electronically transmitted ePHI is not improperly modified without detection

controls.title: Encryption
controls.description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt electronic protected health information whenever deemed appropriate.
assessment_objectives: Determine if a mechanism to encrypt ePHI in transmission is implemented whenever deemed appropriate
